name: Lob
summary: A high, deep, topspin return from far back that keeps you in the point when attacked.
whenToUse: When your opponent smashes or kills and you are far from the table.

keyPoints.bodyAction: Lift with the legs and turn; the stroke goes low to high.
keyPoints.strokeLength: Long: from knee height to above the head.
keyPoints.timing: As the ball drops, often below table height.
keyPoints.batArm: Bat slightly closed, brushing up the back of the ball for topspin.
keyPoints.recovery: Stay back and ready for the next smash.
keyPoints.anticipation: Watch the smasher's bat; move early to the side they aim for.

learningPath.task: Watch the lift from low to high.
learningPath.passCheck: You can say the three cues.
3 sets of 10, then yes to all self-checks.
selfChecks: Did you finish above your head?

learningPath.task: Lob flat balls from far back.
Lob, then counter when a ball comes weak.

gamePatterns.how: Lob high and deep with spin to their backhand; the spin kicks and makes it hard to smash.

fixes: Brush up the back of the ball

penholdNotes: Same action with the forehand face.
